==Description==
The '''Blizzard Bomb''' is the one of four Epic [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''Blizzard Bomb''' has a 1.11% (2.16% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]], 3.08% (4.71% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]] and a 10.17% (10% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[High Grade Crate]], It can also be gotten from [[Holiday Crate]] and has Chance of 8.33% (11.7% with [[VIP+]]) in [[Holiday Crate]].

Only up to five '''Blizzard Bombs''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 20 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 10 seconds. The cooldown does not start until the '''Blizzard Bomb''' explodes.

==Usage==
When using the '''Blizzard Bomb''', your avatar's right hand will hold a radio, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose a bomb drop location for the '''Blizzard Bomb'''. The bomb will create a snowstorm cloud of a 16 stud radius that drops icicles, slowing enemies every 0.25 tick and eventually freezing them in its area for 30 seconds. Freeze immune enemies, either from the regular [[Freeze Immunity]] or the boss freeze immunity cannot be slowed down or frozen. If an enemy is on fire, it will not be frozen, though it will still be slowed down.

==Appearance==
The '''Blizzard Bomb''' is a blue colored metal tube that has holes on each end, at the center of the bomb there is a black screen with wires connecting it to each of both holes.

==Strategy==
*The '''Blizzard Bomb''' is very effective against groups of fast enemies such as the [[Tank]] or [[Rusher]], slowing down large groups of enemies for an extended period of time allowing your towers more time to attack them.
**Do note that some enemies such as the [[Amalgamation]] have [[Freeze Immunity]], making the '''Blizzard Bomb''' less effective against them.
*The Level 4+ [[Sledger]] can work very well with the '''Blizzard Bomb''', as the [[Sledger]] will deal double damage to frozen and chilled enemies.
